newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Country Road sees lower year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Country Road sees lower year profit.

text.p: Clothing retailer Country Road Ltd said on Wednesdaty subdued trading conditions in Australasia in the second half of the year to June 30 meant full year profits may be lower than the profit reported for the first half.

"Directors anticipate that Country Road's full year profit, after abnormal items already reported for the first half, may be lower than that reported for the first half," the company said in a statement.
Country Road reported earnings of A$1.09 million after an abnormal loss of A$3.05 million in the six months to February 2.
The company said its sales remained subdued throughout much of the second half, continuing the trend of the first half.
"While there was some improvement in Australasian sales experienced in early May, sales in the late May through to end July were well below expectations," the company said.
Country Road said trading conditions in the United States had been encouraging and this division had posted a solid increase in sales and was expected to show a modest profit for the year.
Country Road shares closed two cents firmer at A$1.54 before the announcement was made.
